plugins.name: product-brain
plugins.description: The brainify skill + pb CLI: create and maintain a Product Brain hub. Installing puts pb on PATH and makes 'set up product brain' available — no manual copy, no PATH editing.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Commit-message and merge-request rules in every session, a commit-message hook, a ticket-scope gate before MR/PR creation, and verify-ticket-scope / review-mr skills.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks Claude writes that violate shared engineering standards (secrets, debug output, unsafe PHP/TS/React patterns and more), for whichever stacks each repo actually contains. Runs as a hook — nothing is written to your repos.

plugins.name: stack-laravel
plugins.description: Laravel conventions: architecture, Eloquent, migrations, validation, queues and Playwright end-to-end tests.

plugins.name: stack-inertia
plugins.description: Inertia monolith conventions: the Laravel/React seam, typed props, Wayfinder routing, form handling and Playwright end-to-end tests.

plugins.name: stack-angular
plugins.description: Angular conventions: signals, standalone components, change detection, RxJS lifetime, typed forms and Playwright end-to-end tests.

plugins.name: stack-symfony
plugins.description: Symfony conventions: dependency injection, controllers, Doctrine and the messenger component.

plugins.name: stack-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter conventions: widget composition, state management, async safety and testing.
